CustomField.formula: IF( ListPrice >= 1000, "$" & TEXT(FLOOR(ListPrice / 1000)) & "," & LPAD(TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(ListPrice , 1000))), 3, "0"), "$" & TEXT(FLOOR(ListPrice )) ) & "." & IF( MOD(ListPrice * 100, 100) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MOD(ListPrice * 100, 100)), TEXT(MOD(ListPrice * 100, 100)) )
CustomField.label: List Price Formula
